name: Cafe Cuillere
original_name: Cafe Cuillere ～カフェ キュイエール～
source:
Fujishiro Mao is a second year high school student who loves sweets and wants to be a Patisserie Chef. One day, she heard from her childhood friends Sakuma twins that their brother Itsuki (her first love crush) is returning to Japan from France. Itsuki whom is now a Patisserie Chef plans to open a cafe and Mao later finds out that Itsuki have a girlfriend whilst in France. Extremely heart broken, Mao was going to throw away her years of Sweets tasting notes that was intended to be given to Itsuki, but was stopped by her classmate Keita whom she lend the notes to. Keita comforted and encouraged Mao to continue to pursue her dream and that she should give the notes to Itsuki which later that night she did. The next morning she ran into Itsuki's friend Kyouhei who saw her notes and suggest she should start working at Cafe Cuillere and lif possible bring in a few classmates due to lack of staffs. Slightly discomfort with the situation Mao asked Keita to join her with the part time. Turns out the Sakuma twins and Ryousuke will also be working there too!

[from [url=http://gratefullove.blog126.fc2.com/blog-entry-284.html]Nabari no Blog[/url]]
translation:
藤城真央是名喜歡甜食、夢想成為糕點師的高二學生。某天，她從兒時好友佐久間雙胞胎那裡聽說，他們的哥哥樹（真央的初戀對象）要從法國回到日本。如今已經成為糕點師的樹計畫開一家咖啡館，真央後來得知他在法國期間交了女朋友。真央傷心欲絕，正要扔掉多年來記錄的、原本打算送給樹的甜點評價筆記，卻被借走筆記的同班同學慶太阻止。慶太安慰並鼓勵真央繼續追逐夢想，還勸她把筆記交給樹；當天晚上，她照做了。

第二天早上，她遇見了樹的朋友恭平。恭平看過她的筆記後，建議她去Cafe Cuillere工作；那裡人手不足，如果可以，最好再帶幾名同學一起去。真央對這個情況有些不安，於是請慶太和她一起打工。結果，佐久間雙胞胎和涼介也會在那裡工作！
